name: The Rava Liberation Front's air wing
description: A rebel faction at the start of a civil war, with light air power: crop sprayers and light aircraft dropping home-made bombs, two transport helicopters with door guns and rocket pods, a couple of light jets that defected. Planned the night before by a handful of pilots. No suppression at all: night, low flying and avoiding known guns are the only defence. A network of sympathisers tells it where things are; nothing else does. Every airframe is irreplaceable; every raid is also propaganda.
source: croatia_1991_migflug (an improvised air arm of a civil war: An-2s and agricultural, sport and ultralight aircraft with home-made bombs, 1991); every number a game value
notes: The Rava Liberation Front is fictional. The Croatian air arm of 1991 only gives the shape (later than our period). Every aircraft number is a PLACEHOLDER.

doctrine.source: game values: ad hoc planning by a few pilots, night harassment (croatia_1991_migflug: bombs on positions around a besieged town)

harassment.notes: Crop sprayers over the lines at night with home-made bombs.

intelligence.source: game values: sympathisers everywhere (the reach), listening on captured radios, no imagery but a pilot's eyes

logistics.source: game values: a defector now and then, no spares

politics.source: game values: targets chosen for effect and propaganda; the faction's own people are not bombed

events.name: A defector
events.text: A pilot of the federal air force has flown his light jet over to the Front.

events.name: Ceasefire
events.text: A ceasefire is agreed for the funerals: no flying for a day.

events.name: Martyrs
events.text: The Front buries its airmen with honours and swears revenge.

aircraft.name: An-2 crop sprayer with home-made bombs
aircraft.source: croatia_1991_migflug (An-2 crop dusters dropping makeshift bombs); numbers placeholders
aircraft.notes: Night here means willing to fly by moonlight, not equipped for it: accuracy suffers.

aircraft.name: Light aircraft with rockets (UTVA 75 class)
aircraft.source: croatia_1991_migflug (UTVA and other civil aircraft); numbers placeholders

aircraft.name: Mi-8 with door guns and rocket pods
aircraft.source: placeholder: a transport helicopter the faction captured, armed for the game; no value is the real aircraft's

aircraft.name: Defected light jet (G-2 Galeb class)
aircraft.source: placeholder: a period light jet named for flavour; no value is the real aircraft's

backgrounds: deserter from the federal air force

officers.name: Ivo Kranjc
officers.background: Airline captain before the war; flew An-2s for the crop-spraying cooperative as a young man
officers.bio: Charismatic, reckless, beloved by his pilots. Flies the night raids himself and keeps a list of those who have killed his friends.

officers.name: Tomislav Babic
officers.bio: Enthusiastic and talkative; the whole valley knows about his raids before they fly.

officers.name: Mirko Juric
officers.background: Schoolteacher who runs the Front's network of informers
officers.bio: Hears everything in the villages; believes most of it.
